audit.why: 7/10 with Trundle owning level 1 and level 6 and Gangplank owning 3-5 and both item stages matches the kits: a 1000-range keg placement against a 300-range Chomp means he picks every exchange after the first, and his crit scaling beats a Trinity Force Trundle late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every window was hung on 'Powder Kegs', which is charge-based and has no cooldown to play around, so the advice 'Engage only on Powder Kegs's cooldown' cannot be acted on. The ability that actually gates this lane, Remove Scurvy, is mentioned three times without its cooldown.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon: Powder Keg has no listed cooldown — it is charge-based at 1000 range. Remove Scurvy is 22/20/18/16/14 and 'Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health'. That 22 seconds is the real window: bait it with a Chomp slow and every slow you land afterwards sticks for the rest of the fight.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy and its 22s are now the tracked cooldown in the cooldown block, the dos and the report, with Cannon Barrage's 160s added alongside.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three errors and one large omission. (a) early and mid both refer to 'his passive crits' and a 'passive crit auto'. Trial by Fire is a burn, not a crit. (b) mid and whys[4] say Cannon Barrage 'drops a barrel field on your feet' — it is a cannon bombardment that slows, unrelated to kegs. (c) late says Remove Scurvy 'removes the only two tools you have to stick on him — slows from Pillar'. It cures the slow, not the pillar: Pillar of Ice is impassable terrain and the terrain still blocks his path after a cleanse. (d) The omission: a keg explodes for the damage of the attack that detonates it, so Chomp's AD sap shrinks every barrel.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon. Trial by Fire: 'Every few seconds, Gangplank's melee strike will set his opponent on fire.' Cannon Barrage: 'Gangplank signals his ship to bombard an area, slowing and damaging enemies', 160/140/120, global. Powder Keg: 'If he attacks it, it explodes, spreading the attack's damage to enemies in the area' — the attack's damage, which is what Chomp saps. Pillar of Ice: 'becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units' — two separate effects, and Remove Scurvy only answers one of them.
audit.corrected: Crit corrected to the Trial by Fire burn, the R rewritten as a slowing bombardment, the cleanse-vs-terrain distinction stated plainly, and the AD-sap-shrinks-the-keg interaction added to the level-1 spike and the wants.

edits.before: At level 1 you have one real chance — walk up and Chomp him before his first barrel lands, steal a chunk of his AD, and let him know closing distance costs him. The moment he sets his first barrel you have to respect the zone because one detonation chain into your face while you are standing still is more HP than any single Chomp bite. Farm low and step wide of barrel clusters; his auto range forces him slightly closer to trigger them, so wait for that moment to retaliate. His passive crits make even random autos sting, so do not tank free hits thinking your passive regen will catch up — it cannot outpace consistent barrel poke at this stage.

edits.before: Level 6 is the swing point and it is genuinely contested. You get Subjugate but Gangplank gets Cannon Barrage and a Sheen purchase window, and his R lets him deny your all-in by instantly creating a no-go zone under your feet. If you can get on him with Frozen Domain active and W down before he triggers a barrel chain, your AS bonus and Q AD-steal can force him to use Remove Scurvy on the slow — that is your best trade pattern. If he has barrels pre-placed at range and his Sheen is online, do not walk into them expecting W regen to carry you; a full chain burst plus passive crit auto hits harder than one Subjugate steal can answer. Play for moments when his barrel charges are on cooldown and he is standing in the open.
edits.after: Level 6 is the swing point and it is genuinely contested. You get Subjugate but Gangplank gets Cannon Barrage on a 160-second cooldown and a Sheen purchase window, and his R drops a slowing bombardment on your feet to deny the all-in. The trade pattern that works: get on him with Frozen Domain active before he triggers a chain, force Remove Scurvy out with the Chomp slow, then commit — it is 22 seconds at rank 1, so every slow you land after it sticks for the whole fight. If he has barrels pre-placed and Sheen online, do not walk in expecting W regen to carry you; a full chain plus a Trial by Fire burn hits harder than one Subjugate steal answers. Play for the moments his charges are spent and he is standing in the open.

edits.before: You lose a drawn-out game. Gangplank's barrel damage scales with his crit build, his global R turns every dragon and Baron fight into a threat even when he is dead even in the side lane, and his W removes the only two tools you have to stick on him — slows from Pillar and the Iceborn Gauntlet proc if you built it. Your job is to be his jungle counterpart: split a side lane, use Subjugate in every team fight on whoever their frontliner is, and accept that you are not ending this lane with a solo kill past 20 minutes. Win through objective control and resist-draining their tanks in 5v5 — that is the Trundle payoff when the lane itself is a stand-off.

notes: The tracked ability on this page was 'Powder Kegs', which is charge-based and has no cooldown, so 'engage only on Powder Kegs's cooldown' was unusable advice. Retargeted the tracking onto Remove Scurvy (22s at rank 1), which is the ability that actually decides the lane, and added Cannon Barrage's 160s. Three factual fixes: Trial by Fire is a burn, not a crit ('his passive crits' appeared twice); Cannon Barrage is a slowing bombardment, not 'a barrel field'; and Remove Scurvy cures the Pillar's SLOW but not the pillar — Riot's text gives Pillar of Ice impassable terrain plus a slow as two separate effects, and the terrain survives the cleanse. That last one had the page telling the player their pillar was useless into him, which is half wrong.
